title: Lal Kitab Fundamental Rule — Planetary Placement
source: User-provided reference image titled “Placement of Planet”.
principle: The house occupied by a planet indicates its normal tendency in the chart: placement in a house listed as normally bad is normally unfavourable for that planet, while placement in a house listed as normally good is normally favourable. This is a baseline condition of the planet, not an absolute or standalone final judgement.
application: Use this as a fundamental baseline when assessing a planet's condition in Lal Kitab house-wise analysis.
Use this as a fundamental baseline when assessing a planet's condition in Lal Kitab Varshphal analysis.

interpretation_examples.meaning: Sun is normally bad in the 6th House.
Sun is normally good in the 1st House.

Venus.source_marker_note: The source image marks Venus in the 6th House with an asterisk; no explanation for the asterisk is visible in the supplied image.

data_semantics.normally_bad_houses: House placements where the planet is normally considered bad/unfavourable according to this fundamental rule.
data_semantics.normally_good_houses: House placements where the planet is normally considered good/favourable according to this fundamental rule.
data_semantics.not_listed: A house not listed in either array is not classified by the supplied reference; do not infer a classification.

aspects.title: Lal Kitab Aspects
aspects.principle: Aspects are applied in priority order and as a sequence of events: 100% first, 50% second, and 25% third.

priority_order.label: 2nd Priority
source_wording: House No. 3 aspects 9th House and 11th House.
9th House is aspected by 3rd House and 5th House.

priority_order.label: 3rd Priority
source_wording: 12th House is aspected by 6th House and 8th House.

aspects.operating_condition: If there is no planet at the receiving house, the aspect does not work in that case.
aspects.event_sequence: 100%, 50%, 25% — this is the priority order and sequence of events.

data_semantics.strength: The aspect strength category as labelled in the source.
